18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Intentional Tol palette and monospace count badges show craft, but the tree occupies only the upper half of the viewport leaving a large dead zone, and the phylum column feels slightly cramped with right-aligned labels crowding the branch lines.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree uses no quantitative scales, so baseline/lie-factor rules are N/A; categorical color correctly encodes rank, layout dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent, and descendant counts appear as text rather than size — only minor concern is the non-unique key function (name+depth) which could corrupt transitions if duplicate names existed at the same depth.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before starting new transitions in update(), so rapid clicks or triggering expand-all during a 500ms animation causes mid-flight snapping; all other checks pass — search is debounced 200ms, no brush/zoom stale closure risk, pointer events API avoids mouse-touch fight, and no cross-view dispatch loop.
